stem.en: Kabir asks where the diya's oil, sitting cold in its tin, fits. What is the tin of oil?

text.en: Fuel with no loop at all. It sits high on the Hill, from IV.2, behind a hump, from III.6. It is the seed's slow fire with no wall, no steps, no tape, no machines: a fall waiting for a match. Light it and it is the flame; leave it and it is nothing.

feedback.en: A dormant seed has a tape and machines paused. The oil has fuel and nothing else. There is nothing in it to wake.
Energy is on every card. Wood has it, the sun has it. The loop is what uses it to build a loop.

text.en: Dead, because it was once a seed.

feedback.en: It came from a seed, from IV.3, and is the seed's stored fall, pressed out. It was never the loop; it was the loop's bank.

explanation.en: Ask which arrows are present. The oil has one thing: a stored fall. The flame adds the falling. Neither has a tape, a wall or a copy.
